payload.name: Extract Explicit Uses of Tools and Systems
payload.description: Use when a user states what they use an object, tool, system, or method for, listing explicit purposes.
content: During extraction, when a user mentions an item, tool, system, or method and explicitly lists what they use it for, capture each stated purpose as part of a candidate memory, even if the message also expresses motivation or emotion.
Preserve the concrete functions verbatim or near-verbatim; do not replace them with a general emotional or motivational summary.
If the same message contains distinct purposes, keep them together in one candidate for that item, unless they belong to separate memory kinds (e.g., event vs state) that should be split.

solves: When a user explicitly describes the purposes or functions of an object, tool, system, or method they use, extracted memories often collapse these concrete details into a vague emotional or motivational state, losing the specific uses. This skill ensures each stated use is preserved so future questions about what something is used for can be answered.
